Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL203. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id is 'CHEMBL203' and assays.assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures via an inner join to compound_structures on molregno. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
